text:
Line regulation fails because the OTA tail source MB4 is almost in triode (0.031 V margin). Supply changes then modulate the tail current, which shows up as an output shift. Lowering the tail current (W_tail) and widening the input pair (W_in) cuts the pair's Vsg, which raises MB4's Vds and lowers its Vdsat. PSRR, currently at the 60 dB edge, should improve too. The sensitivities point the same way.

```json
{"action": "refine",
 "reason": "MB4 tail source nearly in triode lets the supply modulate the tail current, failing line_reg. Smaller W_tail and wider W_in raise MB4 headroom. Sensitivities confirm. Widened bounds give the refiner room; other specs have large margin.",
 "params": {"W_tail": 20.0, "W_in": 120.0, "L_mir": 6.0},
 "bounds": {"W_tail": [8.0, 60.0], "W_in": [40.0, 240.0], "L_mir": [2.0, 8.0]}}
```
